tools.name: runheed_search_errors
tools.description: Searches the workspace's error groups by text (type, message, route, file or extra data), status and project. Returns each matching group with its status, type, message, route, top stack frame, event count, last-seen time and ID.

tools.name: runheed_get_error
tools.description: Returns one error group in full: message, status, counts, first and last seen, environment, agent context, the top stack frames and the latest breadcrumbs. If the error came back after it was marked resolved, it also shows the note it was resolved with, so you can see what the last fix tried.

tools.name: runheed_get_recent
tools.description: Returns the error groups seen most recently, newest first, with status, type, message, route, top stack frame, event count, last-seen time and ID.

tools.name: runheed_get_trends
tools.description: Returns error statistics for the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days: total, new and resolved counts, the most frequent errors and the hourly error rate.

tools.name: runheed_get_error_context
tools.description: Returns everything recorded around an error: every breadcrumb, platform, runtime, OS, environment, release, the affected user, the agent session and extra data.

tools.name: runheed_resolve_error
tools.description: Marks an error group resolved, with an optional note such as the fixing commit. The group reopens on its own if the error happens again. Returns a confirmation.

tools.name: runheed_ignore_error
tools.description: Marks an error group ignored, for known or expected errors, so new occurrences stop alerting. Returns a confirmation.

tools.name: runheed_unignore_error
tools.description: Moves an ignored error group back to unresolved, so new occurrences alert again. Returns a confirmation.

tools.name: runheed_get_project_health
tools.description: Returns a 0 to 100 health score for a project (or the whole workspace), errors in the last 24 hours, the unresolved count, the error rate, recent issues and recommendations.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
